tools.name: calculate_car_tax
tools.description: Calculate annual UK vehicle tax (VED / road tax) for any car. Handles all three UK systems: cars registered before March 2001 (taxed on engine size), March 2001 to March 2017 (CO2 bands, £20–£790), and April 2017 onward (flat standard rate). Also works out the Expensive Car Supplement: over £40,000

tools.name: check_clean_air_zone

tools.description: Work out when a car's MOT test is due, and the earliest date it can be tested without losing its renewal date.
